_note: Source of truth for the Trusted-by brand strip. Edit here, then run: python tools/build-brand-strip.py
_source: Ported from Tesla7139/OE-DEMO-IN, branch brand-strip-export, export/brand-strip/BrandStrip.tsx

_fields.name: required - brand name, used as the logo's alt text
_fields.reviewer: required - who the quote is attributed to, shown under it
_fields.review: required - quote text, no surrounding quote marks (the card draws those)
_fields.tier: optional - amber pill under the logo, e.g. '8-figure brand'
